in_urdu.name: عُمرَان
in_urdu.meaning: نبیﷺ کا نام، غازى اور باسط نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: عمراں نام سے نبی اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کو پکارا جاتا تھا۔ اس نام کے دو ہیں، ایک عمر بن حزم اور دوسرا عمر بن خطاب۔ عمر بن حزم کا ذکر نہیں ملتا لیکن عمر بن خطاب کا ذکر ہے۔ عمر بن خطاب رضی اللہ عنہ کے والد کا نام خطاب تھا۔ عمر بن خطاب کا شمار صحابیوں میں ہوتا ہے اور انہوں نے نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے ساتھ غزوات میں شرکت کی اور ان کے ساتھ جنگ بدر میں بھی شامل تھے۔

in_hindi.name: उमरान
in_hindi.meaning: नबी का नाम, गाजी और बास्त नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: उमरान नाम से नबी अल्लाह के सलाम पर पुकारा जाता था। इस नाम के दो ही हैं: एक उमरा बिन हमज़ और दूसरा उमरा बिन ख़ताब। उमरा बिन हमज़ का उल्लेख नहीं मिलता है लेकिन उमरा बिन ख़ताब का उल्लेख है। उमरा बिन ख़ताब के पिता का नाम ख़ताब था। उमरा बिन ख़ताब को सहाबी में गिना जाता है और उन्होंने नबी अल्लाह के सलाम के साथ गाजवों में भागीदारी की और उनके साथ बहद्र में भी शामिल थे।

in_pashto.name: عمران
in_pashto.meaning: نبیﷺ د غازي او باسطي نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: عمران د نوم په نبي اکرم صلی الله علیہ وسلم د نوم په کاريد. دوه عمران ديږي، یوه عمر بن حزم او بلکي د بله عمر بن خطاب دی. عمر بن حزم د نوم نه څرګندېږي خو عمر بن خطاب د نوم په ځانګړي توګه یاد کېږي. عمر بن خطاب د پلار نوم خطاب دی. عمر بن خطاب د ګاونډیو کې ځانګړي ځای لري او هغه د نبی اکرم صلی الله علیہ وسلم سره غزواتو کې په لاس کې تله او له هغه سره بدرو کې هم شامل وو.

in_english.name: Omaran
in_english.meaning: Prophet Muhammad's name, name of a warrior and a conqueror
in_english.long_meaning: Omaran was a name given to Prophet Muhammad. There are two individuals with this name: one is Umar bin Al-Hamz and the other is Umar bin Al-Khattab. Umar bin Al-Hamz's existence is not confirmed. However, Umar bin Al-Khattab is a well-known figure in Islamic history. Umar bin Al-Khattab's father was named Al-Khattab. Umar bin Al-Khattab was one of the companions of Prophet Muhammad and participated in several battles along with him. He was also present at the Battle of Badr.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Omaran" may have origins from the Arabic language and potentially holds a nod to the rich cultural history of Islamic civilizations. The suffix "-an" in the name may indicate that the individual is from a mountainous region or comes from a family with associations to such lands. This cultural connection could be a source of pride for Muslims, as the Islamic Golden Age saw significant achievements in various fields including mathematics, astronomy, medicine, literature, and religious studies, many of which originated from mountainous regions such as the Andalusian Peninsula in Spain.
data.spiritual_significance: The Arabic root of the name "Omaran" bears no apparent spiritual meaning on its own, but the spiritual significance of a name is often derived from the values, morals, and actions of the individual bearing it. In Islamic tradition, the word "Omar" is the name of the second rightly-guided Caliph of Islam, Caliph Umar ibn Al-Khattab. This great leader was renowned for his unwavering commitment to justice, his fierce dedication to the defense of his community, and his fierce protection of the religious sanctity of the holy mosque in Makkah. For those bearing the name "Omaran," this historical figure provides an inspiring role model to emulate and strive for virtues of fairness, justice, bravery, and unwavering faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Mountain man" symbolizes A man from the mountainous region. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Omaran serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of mountain man.
